summary: Completed testing of Staff Location Map feature for Quick Wing Fleet Management App. All backend API tests passed (15/15). Frontend testing verified all UI components work correctly including Admin Staff Map tab, Leaflet map display, staff location markers, auto-refresh toggle, and Staff Dashboard Location Sharing Toggle.
passed_tests: Backend: Admin login successful
Backend: Staff login successful
Backend: POST /api/location/update - Staff can update their location
Backend: GET /api/location/my-status - Staff can get their sharing status
Backend: GET /api/admin/staff-locations - Admin can get all staff locations
Backend: POST /api/location/stop-sharing - Staff can stop sharing location
Backend: Staff status shows not sharing after stop
Backend: Staff cannot access admin endpoint (403)
Backend: Unauthenticated user cannot update location (401)
Backend: Staff can resume sharing location
Backend: Admin sees active staff after resume
Backend: Location update with minimal data works
Backend: Location update with all optional fields works
Backend: Invalid latitude correctly rejected (422)
Backend: Missing required field correctly rejected (422)
Frontend: Admin can access Staff Map tab in Admin Panel
Frontend: Staff Location Map displays correctly with Leaflet.js
Frontend: Stats cards show Active Now, Not Sharing, Total Staff, Last Refresh
Frontend: Auto-refresh toggle works (ON/OFF)
Frontend: Refresh Now button works
Frontend: Map shows active staff locations with green markers
Frontend: Currently Sharing Location list displays active staff with time ago and speed
Frontend: Not Sharing Location list displays inactive users with Admin badges
Frontend: Staff Dashboard shows Location Sharing toggle
Frontend: Location Sharing toggle shows current status (Sharing/Not Sharing)
Frontend: Stop Sharing button visible when sharing is active
critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is clean and follows best practices
Location API endpoints properly use authentication decorators
Admin endpoint correctly restricts access to admin users only
StaffLocationMap component uses lazy loading for Leaflet to optimize bundle size
LocationSharingToggle component properly handles geolocation permissions and errors
Auto-refresh interval (30 seconds) is appropriate for real-time tracking
30-minute timeout for inactive locations is reasonable
seed_data_creation: Location data created via API tests - staff user location at coordinates (52.2000, -9.7000) near Killarney, Ireland
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff Location Map feature is fully functional. Backend endpoints: POST /api/location/update, POST /api/location/stop-sharing, GET /api/location/my-status, GET /api/admin/staff-locations. Frontend components: StaffLocationMap.js (Admin), LocationSharingToggle.js (Staff Dashboard). Admin can access Staff Map via /admin?tab=staffmap. Staff location sharing toggle appears at top of staff dashboard. Map uses Leaflet.js with OpenStreetMap tiles, centered on Kerry, Ireland area.
